scope.summary: Author the canonical color-space/profile primitive StudioColorProfile (schema id hsk.studio.color_profile@1): declares a color model, a bit depth, and an ICC (or OCIO) profile binding, referenced by every color-bearing Studio value. A StudioDocument carries a document color model, bit depth, and working-space profiles; individual placed assets MAY carry their own embedded profile. Reference canonical StudioColorProfile from MT-002 primitives; never fork.
acceptance_criteria: StudioColorProfile@1 primitive (model/bit-depth/ICC-OCIO); document + placed-asset profiles; no fork
expected_tests: live: StudioDocument carries doc model/bit-depth/working profiles; placed asset embedded profile preserved

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No color primitive; every color-bearing value untyped; color MTs blocked.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
